title: Izwi Elanqaba Ukuphelelwa Yithemba
intro: Ngena endlini lapho ukulahlekelwa kulandela ukulahlekelwa, kodwa izwi elilodwa elizolile lenqaba ukuphelelwa yithemba. Ubizo olulodwa ku-Qur'an luguqula ukubekezela kube yindawo yokuguquka; ungakwazi yini ukulandelela izinkomba kumuntu ongemuva kwalelo zwi?
clues: Ngangiyizwi lokubekezela endlini lapho izibusiso zazivivinywa khona yinhlekelele.
Ngahlala endlini engenamuntu ngenxa yokulahlekelwa yingcebo nezingane.
Bengazi ukuthi ukugula kwakumhlasele nalowo mngane wakhe, umzimba wakhe wawuhluphekile.
Lapho usizi luba lubi kakhulu, ngamemeza ngikhumbuza u-Allah.
Nganikeza isimemezelo esisodwa: U-Allah uyiqiniso, ngakho-ke hlala ubekezele.
Ngabiza u-Ayyub ngegama; ngemva kwalokho, u-Allah wasusa ukuhlupheka futhi wabuyisela umndeni.

trial.label: Isivivinyo/Umcimbi
options: Ukuhlala no-Ayyub phakathi nokulahlekelwa nokugula, bese kudinga ukubekezela
Isexwayiso sesithunywa esilungile ukuba sishiye umphakathi owonakele
trial.answer: Ukuhlala no-Ayyub phakathi nokulahlekelwa nokugula, bese kudinga ukubekezela

location.label: Isici Esiyinhloko
options: Isimemezelo sokuthi u-Allah uyiqiniso futhi kudingeka ukubekezela
Iphupho lezinkanyezi eziyishumi nanye kanye nelanga eliphumayo
location.answer: Isimemezelo sokuthi u-Allah uyiqiniso futhi kudingeka ukubekezela

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ukuhlupheka kuka-Ayyub kwasuswa futhi umndeni wakhe walulama
Ingane ebilindelwe isikhathi eside yanikezwa ngemuva komthandazo ongenabantwana
Umbusi osemusha wachaza iminyaka eyisikhombisa yenala nokuntuleka
outcome.answer: Ukuhlupheka kuka-Ayyub kwasuswa futhi umndeni wakhe walulama

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
